purpose: Localize every active cached FLIP particle outside the accepted one-voxel cup-interior envelope, bind its Blender particle state and velocity, and classify whether it lies inside the modeled cup solid or outside the cup entirely.

authority.scope: One fresh, local-only, zero-bake, zero-save, zero-render Blender diagnostic on a complete copied cache; ordinary research commit and non-force push are allowed.

priorParticleAxis.finding: Exactly nine active FLIP particles exceed the one-voxel floor envelope at frames 4-7; the peak frame-7 fraction is 9/107825 while the reconstructed mesh previously exposed 7814/101808 below-floor vertices.

sourceCodeBinding.observedRule: particles_fluid_step excludes PARTICLE_TYPE_DELETE records and exposes remaining Mantaflow FLIP particles as PARS_ALIVE.

measurement.particleExposure: Require the retained coherent true/one roster, reuse exactly one evaluated particle system with display_percentage=100, and do not save.
measurement.coordinateConvention: Blender Particle.location world-space converted by cup.matrix_world.inverted

physicalRegions.INSIDE_CUP_SOLID_FLOOR: Within outer radius and between modeled outer bottom and inner floor.
physicalRegions.BELOW_CUP_OUTER_BOTTOM: Below the modeled cup exterior bottom.
physicalRegions.INSIDE_CUP_SOLID_WALL: Between inner and outer radii within the modeled cup height.
physicalRegions.OUTSIDE_MODELED_CUP_SOLID: Outside the modeled solid classifications above.

interpretationRule.activeInsideSolidFloor: The fluid solver has penetrated the cup collision thickness; prioritize time-step/CFL/collision correction before any surface-only tuning.
interpretationRule.activeBelowOuterBottom: The fluid solver has escaped the complete cup collider; treat as a stronger collision failure.
interpretationRule.noActiveOutlier: The prior aggregate is not reproduced; stop and retain the discrepancy rather than claiming a correction.

stopRule: Stop on non-fresh roots, prior attempt-34 drift, source-code drift, source or copied-candidate manifest drift, symlink, cache-root or baked-flag mismatch, frozen setting mismatch, unexpected initial roster, absent or empty evaluated FLIP particles, aggregate/detail mismatch, process/log/result failure, any bake/save/render/network/remote-write count, banned media or resource failure. Never open a retained root directly and never save the in-memory particle exposure.
claimCeiling: One zero-bake, zero-save, seven-frame localization of already measured active FLIP outliers in a complete fresh copy of the resolution-192 static control. It proves particle state, coordinates and modeled-cup region only; it does not prove cause, a physical correction, slow tip, impact, render or finished-film quality.
